fire_id.description: Trigger fire row that produced this invocation.

trigger_id.description: Trigger definition that produced this invocation.

session_id.description: Session or invocation identifier launched by this fire.

shadow.description: Whether this invocation records a shadow fire; nothing launched, billed, or delivered.

outcome.description: Reserved for future outcome-based pricing; omitted until populated, with explicit null accepted for tolerant readers.

started_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the invocation started.

finished_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the invocation reached a terminal state.

root_event_id.description: Root event identifier for cross-fire lineage and trigger-chain correlation.

parent_session_id.description: Optional parent session identifier for chained or nested invocations.

parent_trigger_id.description: Optional parent trigger identifier for chained trigger invocations.

trigger_chain_depth.description: Depth of the trigger chain used for amplification guards and trace correlation.
